modulos.descripcion: Indicadores clave y desempeño global del negocio

kpis.label: Revenue Total
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Unidades Vendidas
kpis.sql: SELECT SUM(Quantity) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Transacciones
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Clientes Activos
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Productos Activos
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StockCode) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Países
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) AS v FROM online_retail

graficos.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS Mes, ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS Revenue FROM online_retail GROUP BY Mes ORDER BY Mes
SELECT Country, ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS Revenue FROM online_retail GROUP BY Country ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS Mes, SUM(Quantity) AS Unidades FROM online_retail GROUP BY Mes ORDER BY Mes
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS Mes, COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS Transacciones FROM online_retail GROUP BY Mes ORDER BY Mes

modulos.descripcion: Distribución territorial y análisis por mercado internacional

kpis.label: Países Activos
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Principal Mercado
kpis.sql: SELECT Country AS v FROM online_retail GROUP BY Country ORDER BY SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Clientes Internacionales
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS v FROM online_retail WHERE Country != 'United Kingdom'

kpis.label: Revenue UK
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS v FROM online_retail WHERE Country = 'United Kingdom'

graficos.sql: SELECT Country, ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS Revenue FROM online_retail GROUP BY Country ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT Country, SUM(Quantity) AS Unidades FROM online_retail GROUP BY Country ORDER BY Unidades DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT Country, COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS Clientes FROM online_retail GROUP BY Country ORDER BY Clientes DESC LIMIT 10

tablas.sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS Transacciones, COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS Clientes, SUM(Quantity) AS Unidades, ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS Revenue, ROUND(AVG(UnitPrice), 2) AS PrecioPromedio FROM online_retail GROUP BY Country ORDER BY Revenue DESC

modulos.descripcion: Análisis de catálogo, productos estrella y rendimiento

kpis.label: Productos Únicos
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StockCode) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Precio Promedio
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(UnitPrice), 2) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Mejor Producto
kpis.sql: SELECT Description AS v FROM online_retail WHERE Description IS NOT NULL AND Description != '' GROUP BY Description ORDER BY SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Max. Unidades/Línea
kpis.sql: SELECT MAX(Quantity) AS v FROM online_retail

graficos.sql: SELECT Description, ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS Revenue FROM online_retail WHERE Description IS NOT NULL AND Description != '' GROUP BY Description ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT Description, SUM(Quantity) AS Unidades FROM online_retail WHERE Description IS NOT NULL AND Description != '' GROUP BY Description ORDER BY Unidades DESC LIMIT 15

graficos.sub: Comparativo temporal de los principales mercados
graficos.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS Mes, Country, ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS Revenue FROM online_retail WHERE Country IN (SELECT Country FROM online_retail GROUP BY Country ORDER BY SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) DESC LIMIT 5) GROUP BY Mes, Country ORDER BY Mes

tablas.sub: Los productos con mayor facturación total
tablas.sql: SELECT Description AS Producto, StockCode AS Codigo, COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS Facturas, SUM(Quantity) AS Unidades, ROUND(AVG(UnitPrice), 2) AS PrecioPromedio, ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS Revenue FROM online_retail WHERE Description IS NOT NULL AND Description != '' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY Revenue DESC

modulos.descripcion: Análisis de comportamiento y valor de clientes

kpis.label: Clientes Totales
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Ticket Promedio
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(line_total), 2) AS v FROM (SELECT InvoiceNo, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS line_total FROM online_retail GROUP BY InvoiceNo)

kpis.label: Mejor Cliente
kpis.sql: SELECT CAST(CustomerID AS INTEGER) AS v FROM online_retail WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Facturas/Cliente
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID), 1) AS v FROM online_retail

graficos.sql: SELECT CAST(CustomerID AS INTEGER) AS ClienteID, ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS Revenue FROM online_retail WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT CAST(CustomerID AS INTEGER) AS ClienteID, COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS Facturas FROM online_retail WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY Facturas DESC LIMIT 15

graficos.sub: Adquisición de clientes a lo del tiempo
graficos.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS Mes, COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS Clientes FROM (SELECT CustomerID, InvoiceDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY InvoiceDate) AS rn FROM online_retail) WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY Mes ORDER BY Mes

tablas.sub: Clientes con mayor valor para el negocio
tablas.sql: SELECT CAST(CustomerID AS INTEGER) AS ClienteID, Country AS Pais, COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS Facturas, SUM(Quantity) AS Unidades, ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS Revenue, ROUND(AVG(UnitPrice), 2) AS PrecioPromedio FROM online_retail WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY Revenue DESC

modulos.descripcion: Análisis temporal detallado y patrones estacionales

kpis.label: Período de Datos
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate)) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Revenue Prom. Mensual
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(monthly_revenue), 2) AS v FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS Mes, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS monthly_revenue FROM online_retail GROUP BY Mes)

kpis.label: Mejor Mes
kpis.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS v FROM online_retail GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Horas Promedio
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM InvoiceDate)), 1) AS v FROM online_retail

graficos.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-W%W', InvoiceDate) AS Semana, ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS Revenue FROM online_retail GROUP BY Semana ORDER BY Semana

graficos.sub: Volumen de unidades vendidas por semana
graficos.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-W%W', InvoiceDate) AS Semana, SUM(Quantity) AS Unidades FROM online_retail GROUP BY Semana ORDER BY Semana
SELECT strftime('%w', InvoiceDate) AS Dia, ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS Revenue FROM online_retail GROUP BY Dia ORDER BY Dia
SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM InvoiceDate) AS Hora, ROUND(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice), 2) AS Revenue FROM online_retail GROUP BY Hora ORDER BY Hora
